verdict.rationale: Built-in embedding generation is a fair axis for a database with vector search, but nothing in the evidence pack shows HelixDB calling model providers at ingest or query time. The vector-index docs only describe ranking stored embeddings by distance with a required dimension and metric, which says nothing about the database producing those embeddings itself.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline
